title: Mission step prompt
description: The structure of a mission step's prompt (steps/<id>.prompt.md beside its mission type), over the parsed Markdown model: optional frontmatter holding only the prompt's detailed description, an optional H1, a preamble and H2 sections (ADR-0044, ruling Q1 as refined on 2026-10-30). The raw-Markdown check beside this structure schema applies ADR-0066's prompt-slot rules: a slot is <!-- <slot-id>:start --> followed by <!-- <slot-id>:end -->, its id is <namespace>:<name> with each part matching [a-z][a-z0-9-]*, each id is declared once, starts before it ends, and slots do not nest. Malformed declarations are prompt_slot_malformed. Descriptor schema_version "1.0" requires only whitespace between paired markers and refuses prompt_slot_not_empty; an unversioned descriptor admits legacy text with a prompt_slot_not_empty warning. The parsed model cannot express those raw-text checks.

frontmatter.description: The prompt's frontmatter: only its detailed description, a longer text than the step's one-line description in the mission-type file.
